news.title: UNI School of Music to host 45th Annual Scholarship Benefit Concert
news.summary_en: "Something Old, Something New" will be the theme of the 45th Annual Scholarship Benefit Concert, hosted by the UNI School of Music.

news.title: New digital exhibit opens the doors to UNI’s Campanile
news.summary_en: A new digital exhibit now lets website visitors explore the historic UNI Campanile from perspectives they may never have seen before.

news.title: Governor proclaims Sept. 6 University of Northern Iowa Sesquicentennial Day
news.summary_en: Iowa Gov. Kim Reynolds has proclaimed Sunday, Sept. 6, 2026, as University of Northern Iowa Sesquicentennial Day in recognition of the university’s 150th anniversary.
